data.long_meaning: Enjansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Enjan', which means 'Lord of the Hills'. This name is often given to children born in hilly regions or to those who are believed to have a strong connection with the mountains. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Enjansh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the hills and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This name is a reminder of the significance of the mountains and hills in Hindu mythology and spiritual practices. For instance, in Hinduism, mountains are considered sacred and are often associated with gods and goddesses. Enjansh, as a name that pays tribute to the lord of the hills, is a reflection of this respect for the natural world.
